Fit the Structural Terms' Own Parameters

Source: R/structural.R
statmod_fit_structural.Rd

Estimates each structural term's parameters on the unconstrained scale of term_links, the coefficients held where they are, by a general optimizer with the exact gradient.

Usage

statmod_fit_structural(
  spec,
  design,
  obj,
  beta,
  hyper,
  optimizer,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

spec

A StatmodSpec.

design

The design.

obj

The objective, from statmod_objective.

beta

The stacked coefficients, held fixed.

hyper

The hyperparameters.

optimizer

An optimizers7 optimizer, or NULL for lbfgs.

verbose

Whether to print a line per term.

Value

A list with value, converged and iterations.

Details

It is a general optimizer and not the scoring step because these are not coefficients of a design block: there is no \(X'WX\) to invert, the predictor being a recursion rather than a product. The gradient is exact – statmod_structural_score chains the filter's own jacobian, which is the total derivative of the predictor in those parameters – so a quasi-Newton method has everything it needs.
